title: Smart Data Models - AIXM - AirportHeliport
description: A defined area on land or water (including any buildings, installations and equipment) intended to be used either wholly or in part for the arrival, departure and surface movement of aircraft/helicopters. (AIXM 5.2 feature AirportHeliport. One NGSI-LD entity per AIXM feature; its attributes are the properties of one TimeSlice, normally the current BASELINE, flattened at entity level, with validTime and the other TimeSlice properties kept as attributes. Property names kept verbatim; nested AIXM <<object>> types keep their structure.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:AirportHeliport:<gml:identifier UUID>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'AirportHeliport'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

identifier.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeature.html#identifier'. gml:identifier of the AIXM feature (codeSpace urn:uuid:): a UUID that stays the same in every TimeSlice of the feature. The NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:<feature>:<identifier>.

endPosition.description: gml:endPosition of the gml:TimePeriod. Absent when the end is indeterminate (indeterminatePosition='unknown'), i.e. until further notice.

validTime.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#validTime'. gml:validTime of the TimeSlice whose properties are carried by this entity: the period during which these values are effective. The efffectivity of the TimeSlice.

interpretation.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#interpretation'. Property indicating how the timeslice is to be interpreted. See the AIXM Temporality model for details. Normally BASELINE (or SNAPSHOT) for an NGSI-LD entity, which carries the full state of the feature.

sequenceNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#sequenceNumber'. Used for the identification of the Time Slice concerned. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

correctionNumber.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#correctionNumber'. Used for indicating the order of the corrections of a Time Slice. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

featureLifetime.description: Property. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Other_AIXMFeatureTimeSlice.html#featureLifetime'. The start and end of life of the feature. See the AIXM Temporality model for details.

horizontalAccuracy.description: The difference between the recorded horizontal coordinates of a point and its true position referenced to the same geodetic datum expressed as a circular error corresponding to the confidence level specified in the ICAO PANS-AIM (DOC 10066) for the specific subject/property. Units: given by uom.

ElevatedSurface.description: AIXM geometry ElevatedSurface. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_ElevatedSurface.html'. A 2-dimensional primitive and is composed of one or more surface patches as specified in ISO 19107:2003, 6.3.17.1, which is extended with properties that represent the vertical position (elevation, datum, accuracy).

geometry.description: The GML geometry of the AIXM ElevatedSurface (gml:pos / gml:posList, EPSG:4326) encoded as GeoJSON (longitude, latitude order). Smart Data Models encoding of the GML part; arcs and circles (ArcByCenterPoint, CircleByCenterPoint) must be densified to positions.

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a vertical distance. For example, Flight Level, metres, feet.

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

elevation.description: The vertical distance of the surface level measured from Mean Sea Level (MSL). Units: given by uom.

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. For example, metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc...

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

geoidUndulation.description: The distance of the geoid above (positive) or below (negative) the mathematical reference ellipsoid at the location of the surface. Units: given by uom.

verticalDatum.description: The set of reference points or a mathematical model of the Earth's surface (a datum) against which vertical position measurements of a surface, are made as basis for measuring elevations.

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. For example, metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc...

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

horizontalAccuracy.description: The difference between the recorded horizontal coordinates of a surface and its true position referenced to the same geodetic datum expressed as a circular error corresponding to the confidence level specified in the ICAO PANS-AIM (DOC 10066) for the specific subject/property. Units: given by uom.

FlightCharacteristic.description: AIXM <<object>> FlightCharacteristic. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_FlightCharacteristic.html'. A specific flight type, such as Instrument Flight Rules(IFR)/Visual Flight Rules(VFR), national/international, Operational Air Traffic(OAT)/General Air Traffic(GAT), etc.

type.description: An indication of a specified type of a flight, such as Operational Air Traffic(OAT)/General Air Traffic(GAT). Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

rule.description: An indication a specific flight rule, such as Instrument Flight Rule or Visual Flight Rule. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

status.description: The designation of a special status for a flight (e.g., Head of State, State aircraft other than Head of State, etc.) Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

military.description: An indication of the military and/or civilian status of a flight. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

origin.description: An indication of the origin of the flight with regard to the national borders. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

purpose.description: An indication of the purpose of the flight. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

LinguisticNote.description: AIXM <<object>> LinguisticNote. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_LinguisticNote.html'. The note content expressed in a specific language. As a minimum, all Notes shall be expressed in English.

note.description: The text of the Note, in a specific language.

Meteorology.description: AIXM <<object>> Meteorology. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Meteorology.html'. A specific set of meteorological conditions.

flightConditions.description: An overall indication whether the meteorological conditions allow visual or instrumental operations. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. For example, metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc...

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

visibility.description: The greatest distance at which lights of 1,000 candelas can be seen and identified against an unlit background (as reported by the airport/heliport). Units: given by uom.

visibilityInterpretation.description: Indicates whether the meteorology visibility is a minimum or a maximum value. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. For example, metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc...

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

runwayVisualRange.description: The distance over which a pilot of an aircraft on the centreline of the runway can see the runway surface markings or the lights delineating the runway or identifying its centre line. Units: given by uom.

runwayVisualRangeInterpretation.description: Indicates whether the Meteorology Runway Visual Range is a minimum or maximum value. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

Note.description: AIXM <<object>> Note. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Note.html'. A general text note for a feature or for one of its properties.

propertyName.description: The name of the feature property for which this note is relevant, if applicable. If no propertyName is specified, then the Note is relevant for the feature as a whole.

purpose.description: An indication of the goal which led to the provision of the free text note. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

OnlineContact.description: AIXM <<object>> OnlineContact. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_OnlineContact.html'. On-line or Network information that can be used to contact the individual or organisation, including eMail address and web site page.

specialDateAuthority.description: Indicates that the SpecialDates associated with the related OrganisationAuthority are applicable to the schedule definition. Reference to the AIXM feature OrganisationAuthority: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

network.description: The official name of the telecommunication network on which a contact's online resource is located. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

linkage.description: A contact's location (address) for on-line access using a Uniform Resource Locator address or similar addressing scheme such as http://www.statkart.no/isotc211 .

protocol.description: The connection protocol to be used for accessing an contact's online resource.

eMail.description: The address of the electronic mailbox of the responsible organisation or individual.

PostalAddress.description: AIXM <<object>> PostalAddress. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_PostalAddress.html'. Physical address at which the organization or individual may be contacted.

specialDateAuthority.description: Indicates that the SpecialDates associated with the related OrganisationAuthority are applicable to the schedule definition. Reference to the AIXM feature OrganisationAuthority: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

deliveryPoint.description: The street address portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

city.description: The city portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

administrativeArea.description: The state or province of an organisation's or individual's physical address.

postalCode.description: The ZIP or other postal code portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

country.description: The country name portion of the physical address for an organisation or individual.

Ridge.description: AIXM <<object>> Ridge. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Ridge.html'. Describes ridges of deposited material (such as a snow-bank) to the left or right of the runway (relative to the runway direction with the lowest designation number).

side.description: The side of the runway where the ridge of deposited material is located. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. For example, metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc...

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

distance.description: Distance of the ridge of deposited material from the edge of the movement area. Units: given by uom.

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement Unit of measurement for depth.

accuracy.description: XML attribute accuracy: The degree of conformance (expressed as a maximum difference) between the estimated or measured value and the true value, based on the confidence level specified for the corresponding property in the ICAO PANS-AIM.

depth.description: Height of the ridges of deposited material. Units: given by uom.

SurfaceContaminationLayer.description: AIXM <<object>> SurfaceContaminationLayer. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_SurfaceContaminationLayer.html'. An operationally significant contaminant of homogeneous type such as snow, ice, slush, water, sand, etc., which is present on a large surface of the airport/heliport area.

layerOrder.description: The order of the layer (starting from the uppermost, towards the movement area surface), in case overlapping contaminants are present.

type.description: The type of contaminating substance on the movement area surface. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

extent.description: The surface covered by the contamination. For runways this can be a runway third, such as in the current SNOWTAM reporting style..

TelephoneContact.description: AIXM <<object>> TelephoneContact. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_TelephoneContact.html'. Telephone numbers at which the organisation or individual may be contacted.

specialDateAuthority.description: Indicates that the SpecialDates associated with the related OrganisationAuthority are applicable to the schedule definition. Reference to the AIXM feature OrganisationAuthority: urn:ngsi-ld:<feature type>:<gml:identifier UUID>.

voice.description: The telephone number by which individuals can speak to the responsible organisation or individual.

facsimile.description: The telephone number of a facsimile machine for the responsible organisation or individual.

type.description: The technology that enables the telephone voice communication. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

Timesheet.description: AIXM <<object>> Timesheet. Model:'https://aixm.aero/sites/default/files/imce/AIXM52HTML/AIXM/Class_Timesheet.html'. The definition of a single time interval, that occurs repeatedly as part of a schedule.

timeReference.description: An indicator of the time reference system or reference system offset (for example, Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), or UTC minus 7 hours), applied to the time, day and date values specified in the timesheet. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

startDate.description: The start date of the validity of a timesheet. Used together with a timesheet's 'EndDate' to express repetitive time periods like 15 May to 15 November.

endDate.description: The end date of the validity of a timesheet. Used together with a timesheet's 'StartDate' to express repetitive time periods like 15 May to 15 November.

day.description: An indicator of the day the timesheet is referring to. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

dayTil.description: An indicator of the days affected by a timesheet, as follows: if the value of this attribute is left blank, the 'EndTime', 'EndEvent', 'EndTimeRelativeEvent' and 'endEventInterpretation' values of a timesheet must be considered as occurring on the day specified. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

startTime.description: The time of the day (specified in the timesheet's 'day' attribute) when the period described in the timesheet starts.

startEvent.description: A reference to an event (like sunset or sunrise), the occurrence of which indicates when the period described in a timesheet starts. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for time. For example, seconds, minutes, hours

startTimeRelativeEvent.description: The number of minutes before or after the event referred to by the timesheet's 'StartEvent' when the period described in the timesheet starts. Units: given by uom.

startEventInterpretation.description: When both the 'StartTime' and 'StartEvent' values of a timesheet are not blank, this explains how the combination of the two values should be interpreted, i.e. which of the two moments in time is the beginning of the period described by the timesheet. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

endTime.description: The time of the day when the period described in the timesheet ends.

endEvent.description: A reference to an event (like sunset or sunrise), the occurrence of which indicates when the period described in a timesheet ends. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

uom.description: XML attribute uom: Unit of measurement A unit of measurement for time. For example, seconds, minutes, hours

endTimeRelativeEvent.description: The number of minutes before or after an event, referred to by the timesheet's 'EndEvent', when the period described in the timesheet ends. Units: given by uom.

endEventInterpretation.description: When both the 'EndTime' and 'EndEvent' values of a timesheet are not blank, this attribute explains how the combination of the two attributes should be interpreted, i.e. which of the two moments in time is the end of the period described by the timesheet. Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

daylightSavingAdjust.description: Indicates that the 'StartTime' and 'EndTime' values of a timesheet have to be decreased by one hour when Daylight Saving is in force (summer time). Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).

excluded.description: An indicator that the time block indicated by a timesheet is excluded (subtracted) from the total time interval(s) defined by one or more additional timesheet(s). Code list value, or OTHER[:free text] for values not in the list (AIXM rule).
